text:
nina chao: Heads-up 1: launch week checklist item: partner hotline + embargo handoff ready? Need short script for SIs and hardware partners.
omar reed: I put a draft in the drive: https://docs.internal/redwood/marketplace/hotline-script-v1 (pls req access). Its intentionally short: 3 bullet points + who to call.
Tara Nguyen: can we add a language line for EU partners (FR/DE)? Some of our SI reps prefer native language notes.
ben foster: +1 for localization. Also want the SLA lines in the script: expected response within 30m for Sev1.
maria gutierrez: legal-escalations  any embargo language constraints we should bake in?
legal-escalations: Do not promise uptime or SLA outside contract. For press embargo: partners must not publicize until our PR window (2026-03-28 15:00 UTC). Add an explicit non-disclosure line.
nina chao: good call. Let's add this line verbatim to hotline script: "Please do not share any materials externally until Redwood issues the official announcement at the embargo time."
omar reed: updated doc and added a short 'escalation phone tree' with redwood and partner contacts. Also included an SMS fallback column.
ben foster: for the landing page cutover, ops will flip the feature flag. Deploy-bot  can you remind the exact command and rollback token?
deploy-bot: Cutover command: `rctl feature-toggle marketplace_public true --env=prod --actor=ops`
Rollback token: `rctl feature-toggle marketplace_public false --env=prod --actor=ops --token=rollback-2026-03-28`
tara nguyen: Can we add a staged traffic ramp plan? Start at 10% traffic for 15m, then 50% for 30m, then 100% if healthy. Add KPIs: errors <0.5%, median latency < 300ms.
maria gutierrez: Marketing requests a microsite redirect plan so partners' badge links work at launch. Does the marketplace slug change?
ben foster: microsite will be /partners/catalog/launch-2026. We'll add redirects for legacy partner badges. I'll add nginx redirect rules to the runbook.
omar reed: hardware SIs asked for a signed-by-redwood asset pack (logo + co-brand copy). Who owns final signoff?
tara nguyen: Marketing owns assets, legal signs co-brand TOC. Maria, can you confirm a turnaround time?
maria gutierrez: We can sign within 24hrs of receiving partner final assets. Add that to expectations doc.
nina chao: quick QA item: can someone verify SSO provisioning flow for partners using SAML? We had one flaky test yesterday.
ben foster: noted. Engineering will run an SSO smoke during the 10% ramp window. If SAML errors >2% in 15m we roll back.
omar reed: added a tiny script to the docs for partners to validate their badge endpoints:
```
curl -I https://partners.redwood.ai/badge/<PARTNER_ID>
# expect 200 and Content-Type: image/svg+xml
```
ben foster: nice. Also adding a monitoring alert to PagerDuty: "partner-badge-404" mapped to partner-oncall.
tara nguyen: last thing  press handling: partners will sometimes get advance questions. Please route all press queries to legal + marketing before answering. Use the single-line holding statement we put in the doc.
maria gutierrez: I'll push the holding statement to the partner packet and email partners the embargo schedule + hotline number.
nina chao: ok locking actions: 1) hotline script localized (omar/tara), 2) embargo line added (legal), 3) feature flag cutover + rollback tokens (ben/deploy-bot), 4) traffic ramp + KPIs (tara/ben), 5) badge validation + redirects (omar/ben), 6) partner asset signing SLA (maria). If everyone confirms Ill export the packet and send to partners tonight.
omar reed: confirmed.
tara nguyen: confirmed.
ben foster: confirmed.
maria gutierrez: confirmed.
legal-escalations: noted and standing by.
deploy-bot: Reminder created: cutover runbook assigned to ops for 2026-03-28 14:30 UTC.
nina chao: thanks team  will send the packet in 2hrs. If anything urgent after that ping me directly. :rocket:
